characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Hypno is a psychic-type Pokémon that relies heavily on inducing deep sleep with its pendulum and manipulating minds or inflicting psychological and physical damage.

mechanisms: Evasion through teleporation or swift movement

limitations: Vulnerable to dark, ghost, and bug-type phenomena
Physical frailties compared to heavy brawlers

sources.supports: Abilities, typing, movepool, and general characteristics of Hypno.

feats.claim: Carries a pendulum that it swings to lull targets into a deep sleep.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Pokédex entry

notableResults.opponent: Various trainers' Pokémon in Pokémon League battles

campaignTags.claim: Hypno is a Psychic-type Pokémon with innate mental powers.
Hypno uses Hypnosis and pendulum swings to entrance opponents and humans.

unknowns: Exact limits of its mind control range outside of direct pendulum line-of-sight.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Ivysaur is a dual Grass and Poison-type Pokémon that fights using vine whips, razor leaves, and toxic spores released from the bulb on its back.

mechanisms: Absorbing sunlight to fuel rapid regeneration or energy attacks

limitations: The plant bulb on its back requires sunlight to store power.
Vulnerable to fire and ice elements.

sources.supports: Ivysaur typing, abilities, and move sets.

feats.claim: Supports the heavy plant bulb on its back using strong hind legs.

campaignTags.claim: Can harness sunlight to recover energy and stamina via Synthesis.

unknowns: Exact weight limit of items it can lift with its vines.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Jigglypuff is a Normal and Fairy-type Pokémon that lulls opponents to sleep using its soothing lullaby song before drawing graffiti on their faces.
mobility: Bouncing / floating slightly by inflating its body
limitations: Physically fragile and easily knocked back by heavy attacks.
Sing requires targets to be able to hear it.

sources.supports: Jigglypuff typing, Sing ability, and evolution data.

feats.claim: Adjusts its vocal cords to sing a song at a precise wavelength that causes listeners to fall asleep instantly.

notableResults.note: Usually puts everyone to sleep and leaves frustrated.

unknowns: Whether its singing affects deaf opponents.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Jolteon is an Electric-type Pokémon characterized by extreme speed and the ability to discharge high-voltage electricity and sharp fur needles.

mechanisms: Spiky fur that deters physical contact

limitations: Completely powerless against Ground-type immunity to electricity.
Fragile defense against heavy physical crushing blows.

sources.supports: Jolteon stats, abilities, and electric capabilities.

feats.claim: Shoots its fur like sharp missiles at opponents.

campaignTags.claim: Can generate and discharge electricity up to 10,000 volts.
Manipulates and fires bolts of lightning at targets.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Jynx is an Ice and Psychic-type humanoid Pokémon that uses freezing kisses, psychokinetic waves, and hypnotic dances to incapacitate foes.
limitations: Extremely vulnerable to multiple elemental types.
Low physical durability.

feats.claim: Dances in a rhythm that mimics human speech and confuses humans.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses innate psychic capabilities and uses Psychic attacks.
Generates freezing temperatures and ice attacks.

unknowns: Precise origins of its rhythmic cultural dancing style.

characters.summary: Kabuto is an ancient Rock and Water-type fossil Pokémon protected by a hard shell, hiding on the ocean floor and peering out through glowing eyes.
limitations: Slow movement on land.
Vulnerable to plant and electric elements.

sources.supports: Kabuto typing, fossil status, and shell defenses.

feats.claim: Resurrected from a Dome Fossil found in ancient strata.
feats.citation: Pokémon Red and Blue Cinnabar Lab event

campaignTags.claim: Lives on the ocean floor and breathes underwater.

characters.summary: Kabutops is the evolved Rock and Water-type fossil Pokémon, utilizing sharp scythe-like arms to slash prey and drain fluids.
limitations: Struggles against heavy electrical discharges and plant-based entanglements.
Relies primarily on close-quarters cutting.

sources.supports: Kabutops evolution, scythe arms, and combat style.

feats.claim: Slices prey with razor-sharp scythes and drains their body fluids.

campaignTags.claim: Swims deftly through the water using its shell to cut through currents.

characters.summary: Kadabra is a Psychic-type Pokémon that emits powerful alpha waves, bending spoons and floating in the air using psychokinetic force.
limitations: Physically weak and fragile when caught off guard.
Sleep or headache conditions severely disrupt its psychic focus.

sources.supports: Kadabra psychic abilities, teleportation, and spoon-wielding trait.

feats.claim: Holds a silver spoon that amplifies its psychic mental focus.

campaignTags.claim: Emits intense psychic waves and possesses telekinetic powers.
Instantly teleports out of danger using psychic energy.

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how it bends spoons with mental focus.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Kakuna is a Bug and Poison-type cocoon Pokémon that remains nearly motionless while hardening its outer shell in preparation for evolution.
limitations: Virtually incapable of active locomotion.
Extremely vulnerable to intense heat and fire.

sources.supports: Kakuna cocoon state, typing, and defense moves.

feats.claim: Scarcely moves while hanging from tree branches, quietly making internal preparations for evolution.

notableResults.note: Often results in stalemate matches due to Harden spam.

unknowns: What happens to its internal organs during metamorphosis inside the shell.

characters.continuity: Pokémon Red and Blue / Standard Video Game Continuity
characters.summary: Kangaskhan is a Normal-type maternal Pokémon that fiercely protects its young offspring in its pouch, delivering powerful punches and tail swipes in combat.

mechanisms: Protective maternal stance shielding the infant

limitations: Vulnerable to fighting-type martial arts.
Refrains from reckless maneuvers that could endanger the infant in its pouch.

sources.supports: Kangaskhan maternal nature, stats, and physical moveset.

feats.claim: Will not give up fighting even if severely wounded, as long as its infant child is safe inside its belly pouch.

unknowns: Exact growth timeline of the infant leaving the pouch permanently.
